writeup: Just Juice Pistachio Cream is a gourmand eau de parfum built around pistachio, coconut milk and heliotrope over a French vanilla, tonka bean and creamy woods base. Woot has the full 3.4 oz bottle, new, for $8.99, while the brand's own site sells the same 100 ml size for $29.99. Stock is very limited, with a limit of 3 per customer.
